title: 第9章 本大王肚子饿了第10章 重操旧业当我的山大王去
content_zh:
竟然要先当三年牛马，才能获得修炼的资格？
反观他身后的其他人，只是有些失望，并没有表现出太多的意外，显然早已有了心理准备。
白锦儿继续道。
“这三年，你们可以靠勤快干活，跟一些外门、内门的师兄师姐换取一些灵石碎屑或者丹药。”
“记住，不要将钱存在身上。”
“有钱就立刻去功事堂购买一些强身健体的丹药，将自己的体质调理好。”
“这样等三年后等你们拿到练气诀，才有希望在短时间内引气入体，只要达到练气一层，便有机会通过考核，晋升为外门弟子。”
“多谢师姐提点！”众人听完，纷纷感激地向她拱手行礼。
他们都明白，白锦儿说的这些，可都是金玉良言。
杂役弟子，说白了就是宗门里最底层的苦力，不仅身份低微，实力也是最弱的。
早点将钱花出去，免得被那些老油条师兄师姐给抢了去。
说完，白锦儿便不再多言，带着众人继续朝着前方走去。
这一走，就走了小半天。
天都快黑了，还没到地方。
你妹的，就好好一个宗门，为啥要建在这鸟不拉屎的深山老林里？
纯小白都有些不想去。
反正去了也是特么当牛马，还不如现在就跑路，随便找个山头，把旗子一插，重操旧业当山大王来得快活！
搞不好，半天时间就能从哪个落单的肥羊身上抢到一本练气诀！
……
纯小白心里刚打起退堂鼓，白锦儿清脆的声音突然响起。

“到了。”
纯小白挤上前一看，只见前方山脚下，稀稀拉拉地出现了一排排破旧的茅草屋。
看的他心头一凉。
“尼玛！”
这生活条件，连他那黑风寨的一半都比不上！
说着，白锦儿直接抬手一翻，掌心出现一个小布袋子，她从里面倒出一堆没有名字，只有编号的黑铁令牌分发给众人。
“拿着，这是你们的身份令牌。”
“记住，平时下山记得带上，要不然碰到宗门执法队，验证不了身份，会被当成别派细作就地处决！”
“这么说，这山头还有点危险？”
纯小白接过令牌，一边把玩一边四处观望，发现除了前面那些茅草屋传来一些人声，压根没看见一个飞天遁地的仙人。
发完令牌后，白锦儿转身便朝着山上外门区域的方向走去。
刚走没几步，她就发现自己的胳膊被人一把拉住了。
回头一看，又是那个讨厌的家伙。
“那个……小姑娘，本大王肚子饿了，饭堂在哪儿？”
白锦儿一愣，大王？
这家伙不会是哪个山头的土匪跑来修仙的吧？
她甩了甩胳膊，发现他那只大手就像铁钳一样，钳在自己手臂上纹丝不动。
“你……你放开我！”
纯小白赶紧松开手。
他可是整整两天没正经吃饭了，又被她带着翻山越岭，现在眼前都开始冒重影了。

走的匆忙，也没带什么干粮。
这也就是他体质过硬，要是一般人早就饿死了。
“杂役弟子，宗门不管伙食，需要你们自行糊口。”
“啊？？？”
那岂不是说，这杂役弟子连牛马都不如？
content_en:
You actually have to work as a cow horse for three years before you can qualify for cultivation?
On the other hand, the others behind him were just a little disappointed and did not show too many surprises. They were obviously mentally prepared.
Bai Jin'er continued.
"In the past three years, you can work hard and exchange some spiritual stone fragments or elixirs with some senior brothers and sisters from the outer and inner sects."
“Remember, don’t keep money on you.”
"If you have money, go to Gongshitang as soon as possible to buy some body-building elixirs and adjust your physique."
"In this way, when you get the Qi Training Technique in three years, you can hope to introduce Qi into your body in a short time. As long as you reach the first level of Qi Training, you will have the opportunity to pass the assessment and be promoted to an outer disciple."
"Thank you, Senior Sister!" After hearing this, everyone bowed their hands to her gratefully.
They all understood that what Bai Jin'er said were all good words.
The handyman disciples, to put it bluntly, are the lowest level coolies in the sect. Not only do they have a low status, but they are also the weakest in strength.
Spend your money early to avoid being robbed by those old youtiao brothers and sisters.
After saying that, Bai Jin'er said no more and led everyone to continue walking forward.
This walk lasted for a long time.
It's almost dark and we haven't reached the place yet.
Your sister, you are just a sect, why do you want to build it in this remote mountain and old forest where birds don't shit?
Even the novices don’t want to go.
Anyway, you are just like a cow and a horse, so you might as well run away now, find a random hilltop, plant the flag, and return to your old career as the king of the mountain!
Maybe, in half a day, you can grab a copy of the Qi Training Technique from some lone sheep!
…
Just as Chun Xiaobai started to retreat, Bai Jin'er's crisp voice suddenly sounded.
"Arrived."
Chun Xiaobai squeezed forward and took a look, only to see rows of dilapidated thatched houses sparsely appearing at the foot of the mountain ahead.
Seeing this made him feel cold.
"Nima!"
This living condition is not even half as good as that of his Black Wind Village!
With that said, Bai Jin'er raised her hand and turned it over, and a small cloth bag appeared in her palm. She poured out a bunch of black iron tokens with no names but numbers and distributed them to everyone.
"Here, here is your identity token."
"Remember, remember to bring it with you when you go down the mountain. Otherwise, if you encounter the sect's law enforcement team and cannot verify your identity, you will be treated as a spy from another sect and executed on the spot!"
"So, this mountain is still a bit dangerous?"
Chun Xiaobai took the token and looked around while playing with it. He found that except for some voices coming from the thatched houses in front, he didn't see a flying immortal at all.
After issuing the token, Bai Jin'er turned around and walked towards the outer gate area on the mountain.
After taking only a few steps, she found her arm being grabbed by someone.
Looking back, it was that annoying guy again.
"Um...little girl, I am hungry. Where is the canteen?"
Bai Jin'er was stunned, Your Majesty?
Isn't this guy a bandit from a mountain who came here to cultivate immortality?
She shook her arm and found that his big hand was like an iron pliers, clamping on her arm and not moving at all.
"You...let me go!"
Chun Xiaobai quickly let go of his hand.
He hadn't eaten properly for two whole days, and she had taken him over the mountains again, and now he was starting to see double images in front of his eyes.
I left in a hurry and didn't bring much food with me.
This means that he has a strong physique, and ordinary people would have starved to death.
"Common servant disciple, the sect does not care about food, we need you to make a living on your own."
"Ah???"
Doesn't that mean that this handyman disciple is worse than an ox or a horse?
